workouts.name: 🏁 Half Marathon – RACE DAY
workouts.description: Half Marathon. Goal: Sub 1:40:00. Pacing strategy: even splits at 4:44/km with slight negative (last 5km a touch faster).
workouts.humanReadable:
Pre-race: Breakfast 3hr before (oats + banana + coffee)
Warm-up: 10 min easy jog + 4×strides 30 min before gun
Km 1–3: 4:50–4:55/km (conservative start, let the pack go)
Km 4–15: 4:44/km (lock in rhythm, run YOUR race)
Km 16–21: Push — if feeling strong, negative split to 4:38–4:42/km
Nutrition: 1 gel at km 7, 1 gel at km 14. Sip water at every station.
Mantras: "Smooth, strong, controlled."

pacing.km4to15: 4:44/km (your race — lock in the rhythm, use HR as guide: 160-167)
pacing.km16to21: Push — run by feel. If you have it, negative split to 4:38–4:42/km

nutrition.preRace: 3hr before: Oats, banana, coffee. 1hr before: 1 gel + 200ml water.
nutrition.notes: Do not try anything new on race day. Use only what you trained with.

raceStrategy.warmUp: 10-min easy jog starting 30 min before gun + 4 strides. Do NOT stand in queue.

taper.notes: Volume drops ~40% over 3 weeks. Intensity maintained via sharpeners.
